patch.summary: Zoom cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: Zoom pricing is plan-gated across 4 researched tiers. Free entry: Workplace Free. Trial/free path present in researched plans. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.

blocks.heading: Zoom cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Zoom against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Workplace Free until a gated capability (call recording (Workplace Free, Zoom Phone US/CA Unlimited, Workplace Pro Plus, Workplace Business Plus)) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (cloud phone, call routing, call recording) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Free Workplace covers meetings/chat — not full Zoom Phone PSTN service. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when Organisations already standardised on Zoom meetings that want to add Zoom Phone requires a paid unlock you will use weekly
Do not overbuy if this limitation dominates: Free Workplace covers meetings/chat — not full Zoom Phone PSTN service
Side-by-side cost with RingCentral on the same seat count

items.title: Cost trap 1
items.body: Free Workplace covers meetings/chat — not full Zoom Phone PSTN service

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: Phone seat floors and Pro Plus / Business Plus bundles are medium confidence and region-sensitive

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: Call recording is higher-plan-only or add-on depending on SKU

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: Power Pack dialer is an add-on, not included on base Phone

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: WhatsApp Business is not supported as a first-party channel
